note: Every committed lifted certificate and the committed runtime it is produced from. scripts/check-lift-certificates.sh regenerates each one and byte-compares. The producer is untrusted; each certificate is accepted only by its Lean Check module (cert_check). A `header` field reproduces the generator comment the certificate was first committed with; the bytes below it are the canonical producer's output. Hand-written Check/Jumps modules (WETH9, beacon deposit, 3Crv) are not generated and are not compared here.
